title: #Healthin2Point 00, Episode 237 | Horowitz and Tiger Global, Medable, Zerigo Health, and more deals

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Today on Health in 2 Point 00.
reader_summary.overview: Today on Health in 2 Point 00, Jess and Matthew talk about Andreessen Horowtiz’s new ventures and the reemergence of Tiger Global in Health Tech. Some big deals for Episode 237: Medable receives 304 million in Series D bringing their total up to $521 million; Zerigo health gets $43 million. Among Horowtiz’s new ventures, Patina gets 57 million despite not having launched yet, and Marley Medical gets $9 million.

key_points.text: Some big deals for Episode 237: Medable receives 304 million in Series D bringing their total up to $521 million.

notes: Today on Health in 2 Point 00, Jess and Matthew talk about Andreessen Horowtiz’s new ventures and the reemergence of Tiger Global in Health Tech. Some big deals for Episode 237: Medable receives 304 million in Series D bringing their total up to $521 million; Zerigo health gets $43 million, bringing their total up to $67 million; Click Therapeutics receives 52 million, but with side deals their total rises to $100 million; Workit Health gets $112 million, bringing their total to $138 million. Among Horowtiz’s new ventures, Patina gets 57 million despite not having launched yet, and Marley Medical gets $9 million.
